goal.title: Resolve GitHub SSH transport key authentication and synchronize github/main
goal.intent: Complete remote publication to github/main for commits 04b9fb8 and f699a68 after adding ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub as an Authentication Key in GitHub account settings or re-authenticating with gh auth login.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Add ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub as Authentication Key on GitHub (https://github.com/settings/ssh/new) or run gh auth login
Verify SSH transport authentication with 'ssh -T git@github.com'
Push local main to github remote with 'git push github main'
Verify commit parity between origin/main and github/main

nodes.contentSummary: Initialized crystal 'github-remote-sync' with goal: Resolve GitHub SSH transport key authentication and synchronize github/main

Origin (Codeberg) is fully pushed and up to date. Local main is at 04b9fb8 (ahead of github/main by 5 commits: f699a68, 04b9fb8, and 3 macos onboarding PR commits). SSH to github failed with Permission denied (publickey) because ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub (SHA256:fZHtH9TBXCGoxd15EjJhPtdnVyfU1eNlJwQ6hpI+L8A) is not registered as an Authentication Key in GitHub settings for user oswaldo. To resume: add key at https://github.com/settings/ssh/new (type: Authentication Key), test with 'ssh -T git@github.com', then run 'git push github main'.
